# Vendored SolidCraft sketch solver

The 2D constraint solver chosen by [RFC 0012](../../docs/rfcs/0012-sketch-solver.md): the
`sketch` crate and the parts of `geom` it uses from
[tangency-labs/solidcraft](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft) at
`6f5d0038abffbd3e1fc26069b1b96ca89984058f`, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 (`upstream/` keeps
the license texts and NOTICE). Nightfall uses it only through `core/sketch/rust`
(`nightfall-sketch`).

Everything here except this README is generated by `vendor.py` and must not be edited by
hand. `vendor.py` reads every input from the pinned commit's tree (`git show PIN:<path>`), so
any clone that contains the commit works, whatever is checked out or lying in its worktree. To
update, fetch the new upstream commit, change `PIN`, rerun, review the diff and rerun the
solver tests:

```sh
python3 -I third_party/solidcraft-sketch/vendor.py /path/to/solidcraft          # regenerate
python3 -I third_party/solidcraft-sketch/vendor.py /path/to/solidcraft --check  # verify
```

Modifications, all mechanical and listed in `vendor.py`:

- serde and thiserror removed: derives and attributes stripped, `Display` and `Error`
  generated with the upstream messages. The crates have no dependencies, so Cargo stays
  locked and offline.
- `fonts`, `text` outlines and every test module dropped; `text.rs` keeps only the
  `TextAlign` and `TextStyle` data types used by `LinkSource::Text`. The upstream fonts are
  OFL-1.1, which WORKFLOW §8 does not list, and none is vendored.
- `geom` reduced to `aabb2`, `chain`, `profile` and `vec`.
- `rustfmt.toml` copies upstream's formatting so the tree passes `cargo fmt --check`; the
  manifests allow `dead_code` (helpers only serde called) and `unexpected_cfgs` (an upstream
  profiling feature).
